Decision record ADR 0007 2030-03-02

Keep sessions in the database, not in memory

Superseded

Superseded by: ADR 0012: sessions in the cache cluster

Decided by: Platform team

Context

The web app keeps each user's session in the memory of the server that made it. With a second server behind the load balancer, a user sent to the other server is logged out (incident 42).

Decision

Keep sessions in a sessions table in the database we have, as the database guide asks: every server reads the same sessions, and a server going down logs nobody out.

Options set aside

  • Sticky sessions at the load balancer A server going down still logs its users out
  • A cache cluster for sessions A new service to run, for two servers

Consequences

Gains

  • Any server answers any request
  • Sessions outlive a deploy

Costs

  • One read of the database on every request
  • Old sessions need a job to remove them
